seo.title: Men's Haircuts in Carlsbad, NM | Divinely Faded
seo.description: Men's haircuts in Carlsbad, NM from Tim at Divinely Faded: the Essential Haircut, Signature Cut and Luxury Grooming Experience. Book on Booksy.

paragraphs: Three ways to book a cut with me, from a clean haircut to the full grooming treatment.

Each one is tailored to your style and the shape of your head, and each one finishes with straight razor work. What changes is how much happens around the cut: the beard, the hot towels, the wash, the steam.

alt.cut-low-fade-line-up: Low fade with a sharp line-up at the temple and a trimmed mustache
alt.hero-tim-at-work: Tim working on a client's haircut in the chair

blocks.heading: Pick your cut.
blocks.lead: Same precision, more detail as you go.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: A precision haircut built around your style and head shape. I clean up the neck with a straight razor and style it before you get up. Book this one when you want the cut and nothing else.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: A precision haircut with a beard trim or line-up, a hot towel finish and straight razor detailing. It's my most popular service, and the right call when your beard or edges need to match the fade.

items.title: Luxury Grooming Experience
items.body: We start with a consultation. Then the haircut, a beard sculpt, a wash and scalp massage, facial steam, dual hot towels, straight razor detailing, a basic hair design, ear and nose waxing, styling and a luxury fragrance finish.

blocks.heading: Which one is yours.
paragraphs: No beard, or you keep it up yourself: the Essential Haircut. A beard or line-up you want sharp: the Signature Cut. A visit where you want everything handled in one booking: the Luxury Grooming Experience.
Plan your time around what Booksy holds: {{minutes:essential-haircut}} for the Essential, {{minutes:signature-cut}} for the Signature and {{minutes:luxury-grooming}} for the Luxury.

blocks.heading: Know the style?
paragraphs: Low taper, burst fade, skin fade, textured crop, slick back. If you know the name, the style pages show what each one looks like. If you don't, bring a picture and we'll work out the length together before the clippers come out.
Want lines cut in? Add a hair design for {{addon:hair-design}}.

items.q: Can I just stop by for a cut?
items.a: I work by appointment only, so grab a time on Booksy first. If you can't find a slot that works, text me.

items.q: Does the Signature Cut include the beard?
items.a: Yes. You get a beard trim or a line-up with it, plus the hot towel finish and razor detailing.

items.q: Is a shampoo part of the cut?
items.a: A wash and scalp massage comes with the Luxury Grooming Experience. With the Essential or Signature, add it for {{addon:wash-scalp-massage}}.
